purpose.zh: 坐姿下放松髋内旋末端
purpose.en: Ease into the end range of hip internal rotation while seated.

text.zh: 脚踩稳，膝盖慢慢向内倒向地面
text.en: Keep the foot planted and let the knee drop slowly in toward the floor

text.zh: 后撑坐地，手臂伸直，双脚宽站
text.en: Sit leaning back on straight arms with your feet wide.

text.zh: 停一下回到中间，再换另一侧
text.en: Pause, come back up, then switch sides.

commonErrors.en: Turning the trunk with the knee.

cautions.zh: 膝或髋疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your knees or hips hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
